description: Return the currently held gantry toolhead to its own slot in the rack. The slot is chosen automatically from whichever toolhead is held, so no index is needed. Does nothing if no toolhead is held.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that drives the CoreXY gantry.

inputs.label: Approach Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Speed for the initial approach move only. Every step after it runs at a fixed 50 RPM.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY A Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY A driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: CoreXY B Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the CoreXY B driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin reserved for a Y maximum limit switch. This machine has no Y-max switch wired; the pin is held inactive by its pull-up and never blocks a move. The usable Y range is bounded by the Y track length and the 5 mm buffers instead. Optional: -1 means no Y-max limit switch is wired.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 1 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 1 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 1 Y (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact Y position of toolhead 1 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 2 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 2 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 2 Y (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact Y position of toolhead 2 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 3 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 3 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 3 Y (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact Y position of toolhead 3 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 4 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 4 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 4 Y (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact Y position of toolhead 4 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 5 X (cm)

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 6 X (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact X position of toolhead 6 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Toolhead 6 Y (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Exact Y position of toolhead 6 in its holder. Edited values become the new default.

advanced_inputs.label: Pickup Clearance (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after collecting a tool.

advanced_inputs.label: Drop Clearance (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after returning a tool. Usually larger than the pickup clearance: a carried tool sticks out further than the bare carriage.

advanced_inputs.label: Dip Depth (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far along -Y the gantry pulls to engage or release a tool. Needs this much room below the tool.

advanced_inputs.label: Engage Lift (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: Small +Y move back after the dip that seats the tool on the gantry.

advanced_inputs.label: Release Offset (cm)
advanced_inputs.description: How far along +Y the gantry rises past the slot position to unhook the tool before settling back onto the slot Y. The drop retraces the pickup exit path.

advanced_inputs.label: Re-check X Home
advanced_inputs.description: Re-touch the X min switch at the clearance position before engaging the tool, and correct the tracked X position from it. Costs a short probe; recovers any steps X has lost since the last home. Y is not touched.

advanced_inputs.label: Rack Approach Speed (RPM)
advanced_inputs.description: Speed for the move across to the tool's Y once the head is at the rack. Separate from the main approach speed because this move ends where engagement begins.

advanced_inputs.label: Home Probe Speed (RPM)
advanced_inputs.description: Speed of the X and Y re-home probes during a tool change. Slow enough to stop on the switch without overshooting, fast enough not to make every tool change a wait.

advanced_inputs.label: Shared Driver Enable Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Shared XY enable GPIO, resolved from the Hardware Map.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the tool change completes.
